主要内容: The Global Skincare Products Market was valued at USD 140.92 billion in 2020 and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 4.69% from 2021 to 2026. The pandemic caused a 1.12% decline in 2020 due to government measures, but online sales rose. Zalando saw a 300% YOY increase in skin, nail, and hair-care product sales. Rising awareness of personal care benefits has boosted demand for natural and organic products. Skincare has overtaken the global cosmetics market, with brands like Sephora, Kiehl's, Vichy, and Bobbi Brown using virtual advisors to engage consumers. Anti-aging and anti-pollution products are in high demand. Manufacturers are entering the market through innovation and acquisitions, such as Gryphon Investors acquiring Ro in 2019. In Asia Pacific, population growth, urbanization, and rising per capita spending on personal care are driving demand. Companies like Johnson & Johnson Consumer Inc., Shiseido, and L'Oreal SA are innovating and acquiring to strengthen their positions. Shiseido launched a sustainable skincare brand, Baum, in 2020, while L'Oreal acquired Takami Co. and expanded in Japan and other Asian markets.
